Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first time the Planner gave instructions to the WebSurfer regarding Ralph Murphy), the Planner failed to include the crucial disambiguating query "Ralph Murphy film director" or "Ralph Murphy director" in the initial list of search queries. The Planner only suggested generic queries like "Ralph Murphy death date" and "Ralph Murphy obituary". This omission caused the WebSurfer to initially retrieve information about a different Ralph Murphy (the musician who died in 2019) instead of the film director (who died in 1967). While the Planner eventually corrected the course in later steps, the initial failure to guide the search with specific disambiguation terms was the root cause of the confusion and the near-miss in identifying the correct individual immediately.
